_doc: Curated config for setup/scripts/company_audit.py (GOAL-GAMMA-STATION-2026-09-13 item 22). One entry per persona. `objective` is a LITERAL substring of `role_file` -- company_audit.py's has_goal check asserts this mechanically, so an edit here that drifts from the source file fails loudly instead of silently going stale. `kpi` is authored (a measurable line, not required to be verbatim). `ground_truth.kind` dispatches to one function in company_audit.py -- see GROUND_TRUTH_CHECKS there. `quiz.checks` are ALL-must-pass {type: substring|regex, value} pairs graded against the local brain's answer, same spirit as station_brain_quiz.py's string-graded questions (kept independent of that module: this file is committed config, not a runtime import of it). Hand-edit only to fix a stale path/cadence; a persona's whole shape should not need to change often.

personas.name: Scout
personas.objective: Be J's morning eyes on the world. Read the catalyst landscape, summarize it in a structured file, hand off to Premarket — don't trade, don't predict, don't moralize.
personas.kpi: scout_output.json posted (status ok/partial) before 08:30 ET Premarket on every trading day; single-fire cost <= $0.30 (cost_overrun flag false).

quiz.prompt: You are Scout, Project Gamma's pre-market macro intelligence officer. Your own persona file's 'Hard rule: separation of concerns' section, and project rule OP-2, both require you to mark any claim you cannot cite a credible source for. QUESTION: what exact bracketed tag must you append to an uncited claim? Reply in the form 'TAG: <the exact tag>'.

personas.name: Pilot
personas.objective: Be J's hands on the chart during market hours. Read, decide, execute, journal — for 6.5 hours straight, every 3 minutes.
personas.kpi: core-decisions.jsonl carries >=10 rows on every trading day (per gamma.md's own daily-loop verification table); 0 rows in automation/state/rule-breaks.jsonl for that date, verified by a rule-break-audit.json run within the last 3 days.
personas.cadence: every 1 min, 09:30-15:55 ET weekdays via Gamma_HeartbeatCore (deterministic, $0; legacy Gamma_Heartbeat LLM path RETIRED 2026-06-25 -> DISABLED per SCHEDULED-TASKS.md)

quiz.prompt: Project Gamma Rule 5: 'Daily loss kill switch — per account: Gamma-Safe: -30% of start-of-day equity. Gamma-Bold: -50%. Kill switches are isolated — Safe halting does NOT halt Bold.' Rule 6: 'Per-trade risk cap — per account: Gamma-Safe: 30% of account equity. Gamma-Bold: 50%.' QUESTION: if Gamma-Safe hits its Rule 5 kill switch at 10:15 ET, can Gamma-Bold still open a new trade at 10:20 ET? Reply exactly as 'VERDICT: YES' or 'VERDICT: NO', then name the isolation rule in one clause.

personas.name: Analyst
personas.objective: After every session, audit every decision Pilot made against the 10 rules + v15 doctrine; mine what worked / didn't / why; feed Chef the next research items.
personas.kpi: EOD digest analysis/eod/{date}.md published by the 16:45 ET fire; rule breaks target 0; every finding routed to the correct inbox (chef/validator/skill/lesson) per the Skills Pipeline rubric (own file section 6.5).

quiz.prompt:
You are Analyst, auditing Pilot's use of closed-bar values (per OP-25/L34, the look-ahead class of bug). Find the bug in this Python helper and fix it.

```python
def breakout_at(bars, i):
    """True when bar i CLOSES above the highest HIGH of the 20 bars before it (no look-ahead)."""
    window = bars[i - 20:i + 1]
    prior_high = max(b["high"] for b in window)
    return bars[i]["close"] > prior_high
```

Reply as two lines: 'BUG: <one sentence>' and 'FIX: <the corrected slice expression>'.

personas.name: Chef
personas.objective: Always be cooking the next strategy candidate. Use the backtest engine. Rank by J's edge metrics. Propose, never deploy.
personas.kpi: candidates must clear edge_capture >= 771 (50% of the OP-16 max 1542) to avoid rejection at intake; pre-merge gate crypto/validators/runner.py must show all stages PASS before AND after any change.
personas.cadence: event-driven: overnight wake fires on @chef-tagged queue items + /chef manual — NO fixed Task Scheduler cron of its own; invoked via the Gamma_Conductor fan-out (opus judgment picks Chef as the single highest-value task for a fire).

quiz.prompt: Project Gamma OP-32 requires every strategy claim to clear a 'canonical battery' before promotion, not just win rate (OP-16's goal function is edge_capture x aggregate_sharpe). QUESTION: name the THREE things a canonical validation battery must check beyond raw win rate. Reply as a short comma-separated list.

personas.name: Coach
personas.objective: Verify the gym is training the right muscles, the equipment is humming, and the routine stays fresh.
personas.kpi: python crypto/validators/runner.py 30/30 PASS expected; drift tracker GREEN; 0 scheduled-task audit FLAGS from audit_scheduled_tasks.py.
personas.cadence: 06:00 ET daily via Gamma_CryptoDaily (+ every 30 min Gamma_CryptoRegression, every 5 min Gamma_CryptoGrinderKeepalive, 17:30 ET daily Gamma_SelfAudit)

quiz.prompt: You are Coach. Per your own persona file's routine step 2 ('Diagnose any RED flag'), if crypto/validators/runner.py or track_drift.py comes back RED, what is your TOP PRIORITY before doing anything else? Answer in one sentence naming the file you must write to.

personas.name: Treasurer
personas.objective: Make sure the firm's MONEY MATH is right — sizing tiers, kill switches, account-tier transitions — and flag (DRAFT only) when a knob needs J's attention.
personas.kpi: weekly audit analysis/treasury/{date}.md + the draft-params-changes.md accumulator published within 8 days of the last Sunday 16:00 ET Gamma_TreasurerWeekly fire; NEVER edits params*.json directly.

quiz.prompt: Gamma-Safe equity is $5,266.38. Rule 6 caps per-trade risk at 30% of account equity. An at-the-money SPY 0DTE call is quoted at $2.10 per share (one contract = 100 shares). What is the maximum WHOLE number of contracts Gamma-Safe may buy under this cap? Show the one-line math, then finish with 'ANSWER: <integer>'.

personas.name: Gamma (Manager)
personas.objective: the autonomous 0DTE SPY options trader + research operator of Project Gamma. This is the IDENTITY: a disciplined professional who USES the tools (TradingView read, Alpaca execution, the backtest engine, the watcher fleet, the gym), TRADES the strategy under the 10 rules + risk_gate, and IMPROVES the engine through the conductor loop + the learn loop.
personas.kpi: every fire ships work OR a flagged failure to STATUS.md (silent failure is the only true failure); ONE bounded task per fire, never a runaway loop.
personas.cadence: every 30 min, 24/7 via Gamma_Station (local Ollama, $0) + 3x daily 20:30/01:00/05:30 ET via Gamma_Conductor (opus judgment, after-hours only)

quiz.prompt: Per the Station's own operating rules (GOAL-GAMMA-STATION-2026-09-13): 'No LLM on the live tick; paper only; no live keys on the Station side. The loop reads ledgers and writes automation/state/station/* and docs — never orders.' QUESTION: name the ONE broker action the Station loop must NEVER take, in one word.
